options.name: account_api_key
options.description: Account API key. Required for API keys authentication. You can obtain your API key from the bottom of the Cloudflare 'My Account' page, found here: U(https://dash.cloudflare.com/).

options.name: account_email
options.description: Account email. Required for API keys authentication.

options.name: algorithm
options.description: Algorithm number. Required for O(type=DS) and O(type=SSHFP) when O(state=present).

options.name: api_token
options.description: API token. Required for API token authentication. You can obtain your API token from the bottom of the Cloudflare 'My Account' page, found here: U(https://dash.cloudflare.com/). Can be specified in E(CLOUDFLARE_TOKEN) environment variable since community.general 2.0.0.

options.name: cert_usage
options.description: Certificate usage number. Required for O(type=TLSA) when O(state=present).

options.name: comment
options.description: Comments or notes about the DNS record.

options.name: flag
options.description: Issuer Critical Flag. Should be set either to V(0) for not critical, or to V(128) for critical. Before community.general 12.3.0, only V(0) and V(1) were valid options. The value V(1) is still available for backwards-compatibility reasons. Required for O(type=CAA) when O(state=present).

options.name: hash_type
options.description: Hash type number. Required for O(type=DS), O(type=SSHFP) and O(type=TLSA) when O(state=present).

options.name: key_tag
options.description: DNSSEC key tag. Needed for O(type=DS) when O(state=present).

options.name: port
options.description: Service port. Required for O(type=SRV) and O(type=TLSA).

options.name: priority
options.description: Record priority. Required for O(type=MX) and O(type=SRV).

options.name: proto
options.description: Service protocol. Required for O(type=SRV) and O(type=TLSA). Common values are TCP and UDP.

options.name: proxied
options.description: Proxy through Cloudflare network or just use DNS.

options.name: record
options.description: Record to add. Required if O(state=present). Default is V(@) (that is, the zone name).

options.name: selector
options.description: Selector number. Required for O(type=TLSA) when O(state=present).

options.name: service
options.description: Record service. Required for O(type=SRV).

options.name: solo
options.description: Whether the record should be the only one for that record type and record name. Only use with O(state=present). This deletes all other records with the same record name and type.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the record(s) should exist or not.

options.name: tag
options.description: CAA issue restriction. Required for O(type=CAA) when O(state=present).

options.name: tags
options.description: Custom tags for the DNS record.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Timeout for Cloudflare API calls.

options.name: ttl
options.description: The TTL to give the new record. Must be between V(120) and V(2,147,483,647) seconds, or V(1) for automatic.

options.name: type
options.description: The type of DNS record to create. Required if O(state=present). Support for V(SPF) has been removed from community.general 9.0.0 since that record type is no longer supported by CloudFlare. Support for V(PTR) has been added in community.general 11.1.0.

options.name: value
options.description: The record value. Required for O(state=present).

options.name: weight
options.description: Service weight. Required for O(type=SRV).

options.name: zone
options.description: The name of the Zone to work with (for example V(example.com)). The Zone must already exist.
